We have recently had a couple of players unclaim their countries and claim again straight away. There are a couple of issues with this. Firstly, unclaiming when you have important posts pending means that the mods have to deal with the mess you left behind. There is also the issue of people intentionally ruining their countries in order to create a scenario where they can claim a new country. For example, a US claimant could create a situation where Texas was separated from the US and available to claim, then unclaim and claim Texas. For this reason, there will now be a cool down period of one week before you are allowed to claim again after you unclaim. If we think you have created a situation purely to allow yourself to claim another country, your claim might be rejected.
